title: DtMF World Tour — Barcelona Night 2 at Estadi Olímpic; Bad Gyal Guests on 'Yo Perreo Sola' as European Leg Continues
detail: Bad Bunny completed his two-night run at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona on May 23, 2026 — the second sold-out show (54,000 capacity per night) of the European stadium leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour, his first European stadium concerts in six years. Night 2 opened with 'BAILE INoLVIDABLE,' rotating the setlist from Night 1's 'LA MuDANZA' opener, a distinctive touch that gave Barcelona fans a different experience both nights. Catalan-Puerto Rican artist Bad Gyal made a surprise guest appearance during 'Yo Perreo Sola,' joining Bad Bunny on the roof of 'La Casita' — the replica Puerto Rican countryside home used as a second intimate elevated stage at the center of the arena. During 'Safaera,' Bad Bunny delivered a speech defending the freedom of women and the LGBTQ+ community — consistent with his longstanding public advocacy. Both Barcelona nights drew widespread coverage from Spanish media, with Ara.cat calling the shows 'an unforgettable effervescence' and El Constitucional describing the performance as 'a historic night' that 'transforms Barcelona into a party with Puerto Rican soul.' With Barcelona concluded, the European leg moves to Lisbon (May 26–27, Estádio da Luz) and then begins a 10-night Madrid residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano starting May 30. The DtMF World Tour continues through July 22, 2026 in Brussels.
